question: Is the C1 simulation saving specific to the learned V-JEPA prior, and how does it scale with initialization quality?

subset.rule: per (GT law, observed action) cell one random sample (18) + per law a second sample from 4 random actions (12)

refinement.objective: (1 - mean object-mask IoU) + RGB-MAE(union)/255 vs observed 3-view 128-frame video
refinement.optimizer: deterministic opportunistic compass search over log10(E/rho) [+ log10(sigma_y/rho) unless law=jelly], initial step 0.5 decade, halved after an unsuccessful poll; bounds E [1.5,6.5], sigma_y [-0.5,5.0]
refinement.law: fixed at the arm's start law (MAP / GT); no law probes
refinement.nested: budget k = best observed loss among the first k simulations; k=0 = start point
refinement.failure_rule: quick crash (<60 s) retried once; failed sims get loss 9, count toward the budget, never selected; no sample dropped

metric: identifiable z-MAE: |z_hat - z_gt| on E/rho and sigma_y/rho (train-standardized ln1p specific; sigma_y only where defined), pooled over (sample, target) elements; CIs = object-clustered bootstrap (2000 draws, seed 17)

arms_new_primary.dino_c: seed ensemble of runs/v3c_dino_C_seed{17,29,43} (best val epoch): mean prediction_z, majority-vote law (1/1/1 tie -> law whose train-mean E/rho z is closest to the mean prediction); nu = decoded ensemble nu
arms_new_primary.gtnoise_0.25: PRIVILEGED: GT law; x0 = clip(log10 GT (E/rho, sigma_y/rho) + 0.25 * eps), eps ~ N(0, I2) one fixed draw per sample (listed below; the same eps is scaled for every level); nu = train mean nu of the GT law (as lawmean_gt)
arms_new_primary.gtnoise_0.5: PRIVILEGED: GT law; x0 = clip(log10 GT (E/rho, sigma_y/rho) + 0.5 * eps), eps ~ N(0, I2) one fixed draw per sample (listed below; the same eps is scaled for every level); nu = train mean nu of the GT law (as lawmean_gt)
arms_new_primary.gtnoise_1: PRIVILEGED: GT law; x0 = clip(log10 GT (E/rho, sigma_y/rho) + 1 * eps), eps ~ N(0, I2) one fixed draw per sample (listed below; the same eps is scaled for every level); nu = train mean nu of the GT law (as lawmean_gt)

arms_new_secondary.ens_map: run only if time permits, after all primary jobs: 9-run B/C/D V-JEPA ensemble (docs/v3b/ENSEMBLE_BCD9_VAL.json) mean prediction, top-1 vote law, NO probes (same protocol as dino_c)

arms_reused.prior: data/v3b_refine/v2main_C_seed29/<idx>/state.json (single V-JEPA C seed29, MAP law, no probes)
arms_reused.prior_top2: .../prior_top2 (9-run ensemble, 2 law probes counted in the budget)
arms_reused.lawmean_gt: .../lawmean_gt (PRIVILEGED GT law, train mean of that law)
arms_reused.lawmean_best3: .../lawmean_best3 (3 law-mean probes counted; first point at k=3)

analyses: per arm: identifiable MAE at budgets 0/4/12 (and full 0..12 curve) on the 30-sample subset; final error vs initial (budget-0) error

sims to reach target T = lawmean_gt pooled MAE at 24 sims on the same subset (also T12 = lawmean_gt at 12), linear interpolation in k on the 0..12 (reused arms: 0..24) curve; censored if not reached; object bootstrap CI
paired differences vs lawmean_gt at the same budget (object bootstrap)
breakdown of the existing 60-sample C1 results by observed action and by GT law (prior, prior_top2, lawmean_gt, lawmean_best3)

addenda.change: secondary arm ens_map NOT run on the 30-subset; replaced by prior_top1 (same init: 9-run ensemble, top-1 law, no probes) on ALL 60 C1 val samples via scripts/v3d/c1_refine.py --split val, budget 24, replay 0/4/12/24, shared r_queue on a800-2 (docs/v3h/queue.json). Primary arms unchanged; the a800-4 pool was split into two disjoint job files (GPUs 4-7: jobs.json, GPUs 0-3: jobs_a8004_gpu0123.json).
